segments.text: Today we're sitting by the window in a French style cafe,
that displays the bright blue sky.
Actually, discussing global trends of the time,
or the turbulence of the foreign stock market is the normal thing to do,
yet we were together gossiping about old classmates that are doing well.
Were you not able to sign the contract with President Song?
Im Tae San already sacrificed his body for it.
Just thinking that according to Korean age, we're already 40.
Maybe we've already hit that age where we can't even tell that someone else likes us.
"The age of 40", meaning that at age 40 you won't be seduced...
by anything in the world anymore.
We're still, as before, and always will be, men.
Is there still food to eat in the fridge?
If you're going to order takeout, you might as well go out and buy groceries.
Why does your face look so terrible?
That person that is Tae San's business partner, do you know him?
How do you know Kim Do Jin?
I met him briefly at the baseball field.
What kind of person is he?
Since you've met him already, you should know, too.
Good looking and capable, therefore there are always a lot of women around him.
Hence, he naturally becomes a very selfish person.
He's a little too cool and seems a bit cold.
You are going to go, right?
Should I first settle with him?
Or should I first solve this problem?
Just because it's a make-up class doesn't mean that you can sleep soundly.
I'll take care of the settlement first.
Gather at the school's front gate in 10 minutes.
Of course all of you have to come!
We would like to formally apologize to you.
I can't even remember what happened.
Although it's a bit late, please consider their sincerity.
Just looking at their posture, it doesn't seem to be formal at all,
They've been reflecting on their behavior.
I hope that you can agree to a settlement.
You seem to be a very outstanding teacher.
Your own personal problems seem to be complex enough.
I hope that you don't misinterpret my meaning to be "take care of yourself".
Why did you go pick a fight?!
A man that's not easy to deal with.
In our shop, I'm the one who's hardest to deal with.
I'm looking for a type of coffee that suits a man that's hard to deal with.
I know a guy like that.
He's very selfish, not at all considerate, and he's really cold.
Yes, exactly that type of man.
What kind of coffee does that person like to drink?
You like Tae San, don't you?
In another words, a one-sided love.
I didn't know what kind of flavor you liked.
My taste can't be guessed so easily.
This is double, this is triple.
Can you make some time for me?
Do I have to wait again?
How much longer do I have to wait?
Don't be shameless like last time and...
Do you really not know who I am?
Do you not remember where you've seen me before?
I really want to remember, too.
Let's talk about it next time.
When did you have to meet someone?
Does he know what that means?!
I've never met someone who meets up like this.
If you have time can you contact me?
I'll wait for your phone call.
Let's first talk about the settlement.
We can talk about other things later.
I'm a teacher and you're a...
That guy knows the problem that my butt caused in the spring.
I hope that next time the person that you have an appointment with is me.
Why are you so tired looking?
Are you going to a party?
Nope, I'm going to meet Tae San.
We're going to have a big fight.
You're going to have a big fight and you're wearing that?
Can I not look pretty while arguing?
When you're the umpire, do you go alone?
Don't you wear all your protective gear?
So I failed because I went to meet him wearing this.
Why does that person have to be that person?
Will something else come between him and me again?
Most respected customer, this message is an appointment message.
When you're reading this message I might...
In other words, I'll be at Incheon Airport really soon!
What did Kim Joo Won say?
Why are you always in so much pain?
When you're with me, even in your dreams, are you unhappy?
Tomorrow and the day after tomorrow.
What lunchbox is so exquisite like this?
Even if we only eat a meal, we have to be classy.
We have to eat till we're full and eat well.
That's why when we're mixing cement don't mix in cigarette buds and stuff, all right?
If so, then it'll crack easily.
She can give Miss Korea a run for her money.
Are you not going to go meet her?
She's the kind of woman that you can't meet without some protection.
I'm in the middle of work.
Either I've come to coolly break up with you...
or ask you to not forget me and make up.
It should be one of those two.
Which do you think it is?
It could be to break up.
It should come from your mouth, but I took the chance away from you.
If that hurts your pride, then hurry and finish what you have to say and leave.
Do you not want to make up?
No, because I did nothing wrong.
If you came wanting to hear me apologize, then you're wasting your time.
There are lots of guys lining up for me with diamonds, imported cars, and apartment keys.
So you don't need to worry about me and live your own life.
Or one who gave you all three of those things?
You really lost a lot of weight!
You really weren't kidding about being a goddess now.
I originally planned to come next month, but I've come early.
Take me in for a couple of nights.
Tae San's going to be sad.
His little sister that he hasn't seen in two years is hiding in a friend's place.
It hasn't been two years since we met.
Se Ra and Tae San came to New York.
Teacher, about me coming back to Korea, you must not tell Yoon.
I've rested for a few days and gained two kilograms.
I need to lose it before I meet him.
Then, why are you losing it in my house?
You can lose it in your house too.
What if Yoon suddenly comes to my house?
Do you think she'll swiftly agree to let you stay?
To put it simply, let me stay here for a few nights and hide it from my brother.
What is there to be so self-assured about staying here for a few nights?
And don't you not like me?
That doesn't mean I don't like your house.
Did you hear what she just said?
You should boldly express your personal opinions.
I'll take that as you agreeing.
And don't you dare to bully my teacher.
How can she be so different from her brother?
We won't know that until the future.
You need to have an idea now or you won't have those things in the future.
Was Tae San supposed to come over?
Make him leave by the time I'm done.
How many guests do we have today?
Stay in here, don't come out.
Even if her mouth slipped, it wouldn't be that fast.
You took my pen, didn't you?
It looks exactly like a fountain pen.
I use that to take memos.
You were the very last person to use it.
Although, I don't know how great that pen is...
There's no need to get so angry over it.
Then I'll dump it all out in front of you for you to see.
This is the purse that I carried today.
After coming home, I haven't touched it.
This was on purpose, wasn't it?
If you were going to do that then why did you make me wait you jerk
All of these mean the same thing.
I'll explain it all to you.
Why is it all happening at once?
That person outside, I shouldn't have met him.
I don't see you or the car.
Both are on their way home.
Didn't you come for the settlement?
Going there, that's what I thought, but I changed my mind.
You didn't change your mind because you...
had to wait a few minutes, did you?
A moment ago in the office you pointedly...
Bad students and documents of defamation, stealing fountain pens,
there's a limit if you want to settle.
I'm still thinking of how I should deal with you.
I will disclose that what I'm considering is promoting good and destroying evil.
I'm even more unlucky than a moment ago.
From his lips he dare say to promote good and destroy evil.
Is your settlement with Do Jin going well?
Hey, what did you do with my phone?
I was just curious about what Yoon is doing today.
We should just send her off.
If that's what you really want.
They say a sister-in-law trying to resolve a fight is meaner than mother-in-law who hits.
What is it that you're trying to resolve with Do Jin?
I'm in the middle of resolving it.
It's not going as well as I hoped.
You've been texting with that woman?
Why is that jerk still not here?
Did he really go to the bathroom?
This phone, his wife can trace its place.
He said that he's with us.
What should we do with this?
Of course we should answer it.
If that punk is caught this time then he'll divorce immediately.
Sooner or later I'll be told off.
You're the only one who can.
Are you now asking a lawyer to create false evidence?
Can we just watch them divorce?
Jung Rok just went to the bathroom...
We just wanted to have a little drink.
We must go immediately to Rich.
You're really bad at falsifying evidence.
I can listen to praise later.
Rich is really close to here.
How do we delay the time?
She said that she saw Rich nearby and I can't say a place in the opposite direction.
The variance can't be too big.
Min Sook didn't drive her car over?
It's peak traffic time right now.
Alcohol for four people and make it look like we've had a few drinks already.
The snack food, make it look like we've only had a few bites.
I'll tell you the reason later.
And you said you can't falsify evidence?
But how do we call Jung Rok?
Why are you just saying that now?!
Hi dear, why are you here?
When you went to the bathroom a moment ago I answered a call from her.
Come on over and have a seat, Min Sook.
I was just passing by and thought that it's been a long time since I saw you guys.
Since I've now seen you guys, I should leave.
I forgot to say that I've already paid.
And I spent a little more along with it.
You normally don't have fun, so I wanted you guys to have a good time.
Oppas, are you not going to play?
Thanks for your good intention, but it's all right.
You guys have fun, don't worry about us.
It's the first time that I've been to a place like this.
I haven't been able to settle with him.
And instead he found out about my secret.
Knocking on my door, too, I've even been suspected of stealing his pen.
Now even the past that I've been trying to cover will be exposed.
We looked at each other and he hugged me around the waist...
If you dare tell Tae San about these things...
I'm with Tae San, ask Me AhRi to hurry and choose her destiny
Se Ra and Tae San are heading here right now.
She told you to hurry and hide.
I was just thinking of calling you.
Has Do Jin written a settlement for you yet?
I thought something was amiss so I beat him until he confessed.
Actually, that jerk has nurtured a weird personality.
She said that Kim Do Jin is gross.
Let me take care of this.
Please do not discuss with him anything about me.
No, don't even mention my name in front of him.
I think Kim Do Jin has a bad impression of me.
If you think so, then there's nothing I can do.
If I get involved, perhaps you will be able to more quickly...
Yes, then I'll look at you.
But where exactly should I look...
Today, after eating dinner, you should just stay the night.
You know I'm a light sleeper!
The walls are thin, and every noise...
I'm here to share the gospel.
Don't you know that I'm really cool?
But you must immediately make Me Ah Ri leave.
Why did she have to go in there?
who told you to enter the pastor's house?
She knew that I was here.
Why did she bring him back?
And after that she even dared to ask me why I hate her?
Can you yell at me when I'm not here?
At least I only say those things when you're not here.
The noise insulation is so bad.
I'll say it when you aren't here too.
Because there's too many things I have to say.
You didn't do anything right either.
When are you going to leave?
I was already planning on leaving tomorrow.
Since I've starved for two days, I look a lot slimmer, don't I?
Do you like to throw passes that much?
That's why I said to go play golf.
Why are there so many ambassadors promoting golf around me?
There's nothing bad about learning it.
Why are you standing on his side?
You should be on my side.
I'm not looking at the person, but the perspective.
Whenever he doesn't agree with you, you start to act nervous.
Amongst us, he's the smartest, too.
Hey, my grades were about the same as his, all right?
You only know information, you don't have the intelligence.
Write the list of coffee beans that we need.
When I come back in a bit, I'll review it and order them.
Do you live in this neighborhood?
So what if I live in this neighborhood?
I live in this neighborhood, too.
It's a pleasure to meet you.
I think that you live in the neighborhood right next to this one.
Maybe it's written on my face "I live in Gangnam".
But it does say "I'm a married ahjusshi".
Why did you come back so early?
Weren't you supposed to come next month?
I just moved it up a bit.
Took advantage of the airplane discounts.
What surgery did you do to your face?
Can you only compliment that someone looks pretty in that way?
To your friend's little sister, how can you speak like that?
Oppa, a moment ago Jung Rok told me...
Me Ah Ri, Me Ah Ri!
I'm really happy to see you.
Oppa, just a minute ago to me he...
Who moved your luggage for you?
At what time did you arrive?
How did you get here from the airport?
I got here safely, came here safely,
What you just said, say it in English.
I really do have a return on my investment.
Is this all of your luggage?
That isn't your room right now.
Who told you to come back without letting me know?
You don't need to know about that.
I thought that you were coming next month.
I was planning on telling him in two days.
It might be a little uncomfortable but for now, use the work room.
Since I'm here will Yoon have to leave?
We can all just live together.
Do you know what I mean?
What else if that isn't all?
Just think that you're someone's unfinished first love.
Where are you going to stay?
Going to have to start looking.
I took it yet kept insisting that I didn't.
I'm very sorry about that also.
I definitely didn't do it on purpose.
Since I found it, forget about it.
You like Tae San don't you.
If you need time to prepare yourself then let's eat first.
The teacher for the ones being sued.
What would you like to eat?
I never said that it's just us two eating.
If you don't want to, then forget it.
I never said I didn't want to.
What kind of group is this?
She said that she missed me,
Teacher Seo said she had something to tell me, and I already had plans with you.
I have something to say to Yi Soo too...
Anyway, there's traffic at this time now.
Teacher Seo probably can't eat anything right now.
No, I have something to do.
I hoped to resolve it today.
Didn't you have something that you haven't said yet?
Didn't you come here to answer my questions today?
Is that jerk torturing you now?
You just need to say something.
I'm sorry, I need to go.
Excuse me for a moment, too.
Although I can choose to not listen,
but if you must tell me, then now's your only chance.
Compared to a woman's craftiness, I will believe more in my own judgment.
Let me have a listen to what sort of answer you'll give.
I said that it's a misunderstanding.
Yi Soo said that she's going to treat it as if she never liked you.
What are you doing right now?
yet you got so scared that your face turned white and you started yelling.
And you still insist that you don't?
I didn't come to find you.
Yes, we talked on the phone.
I heard that she lost a lot of weight.
Even her voice sounds like she's lost a lot of weight.
Yeah, it feels like I've lost a sister.
Take advantage when I'm still speaking nicely to you and hurry and settle.
Do you not think that Yi Soo will think it to be very interesting also?
We were just discussing when we were going to write the settlement.
Why are you blindly joining and disturbing us?
We were just scheduling a time.
We agreed on two tomorrow right?
The women's bathroom on the second floor here,
The window near the entrance should be moved more towards the side.
Of course we must write it now.
How can there be someone like this?
Should I take a picture of it?
Who writes a settlement letter in the sand?
You must write it on paper.
Do you want it written on paper?
Tae San, I didn't think that I would need to ask for your help.
But Kim Do Jin doesn't seem to be like a good person.
He doesn't seem to intend to settle with me.
Tae San, Teacher Seo seems to be saying bad things about me.
If she's going to say it, she should call me, not talk behind by back like a coward.
Oh no, oh no, now what?
Fine, let's take this as far as it will go.
Tae San, I think Kim Do Jin has a misunderstanding.
Should I meet him in person and clear things up?
Tae San, I'm going to Nonhyeon-dong 425-1 right now.
If I ask Seo Yi Soo to come right now, will she?
Tae San, I'm going to go meet Kim Do Jin right now.
Tae San, if I agree to a settlement, Seo Yi Soo will probably treat me to a meal, right?
Tae San, as long as there's a settlement,
instead of a meal, I can buy a rice farm.
Don't grow rice, can you ask her to grow grapes for me?
When will the settlement be written?
You haven't paid for the bill yet.
You're supposed to pay for the bill after you leave.
Who knows whether or not you'll actually pay.
Why are you looking at me like that?
You steal little things like pens, then you'll steal big things like cows.
Although I'm now like a helpless fish in the hands of a person and shouldn't be say this,
but I feel like I've already done my best to do as you pleased.
Is this perhaps my punishment for not remembering you?
Like you said last time, "encourage good, punish evil"?
This is the only way I could think of to see you.
I fell for you at first sight, you see.
Then how about if I told you that I fall for you every time I see you?
Why do you like Tae San?
I don't know why I have to explain to you my one-sided love but,
Actually, I've never had the spare time to wonder why I like him.
From the first moment that we met, I liked him,
and every time we meet, it just increases my love for him.
Now, even if I don't see him I like him.
Then no matter which side he chooses,
it should be better if you can make a decision as soon as possible.
Either you look for someone else...
or cheat with your roommate's boyfriend.
My one-sided love, I'll take care of it on my own.
It matches my personality and I'm pretty gifted at it.
So, my one-sided love, please stop peering at it.
Because I don't need an audience.
Please keep my secret for me.
I have to settle with you and keep your secret.
You have a lot of requests.
I already mailed the settlement to the police station this morning.
The police will take responsibility for everything else.
I hope next time, I'm your previous appointment.
Seeing the consolation money in my bank account,
I feel like those scary three years and everything I endured was worth it.
Although, I can't be paid for how my firm skin was affected by the pain in my heart.
Words like that will make my heart flutter.
You're so sexy in the court room,
yet normally you seem like a shy teenager.
Thanks a lot for this time.
Your face looks like you completely didn't know.
Then, what about having dinner with me?
I knew you wouldn't take up on the offer.
If I divorce again next time, I'll come back.
From now on you must be happy.

7 to 7:20, going to Jamshil for a family gathering.
9:10 to 9:40, I'm going to Sinseoldong for a college classmate gathering.

Hey, I'm a teacher, and you...

are about to be sent to Im Tae San's address.

If we're going to die, then we'll die together!
